== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Yaggle Gakkle (Japanese)|Yaggle Gakkle]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/147361097/rUIqnWaB-EGpsOm9_D6SAA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 80497039.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c7bc9c2101f2255e6db3435a86166def68656fdcd1cb573f65a221e7d02e38e7</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
